The classifiers' failure to identify the objects as 'turtle', 'cookie', or 'cow' (predicting 'ocarina', 'dough', etc.) further suggests the geometry deviates from standard biological/physical norms, even if visually plausible at a glance.

Texture fusion: Chocolate chips blend softly into the cookie dough instead of having distinct boundaries.
